title: Cultural origins of preventive health care utilization
title_zh: 预防性医疗保健利用的文化起源
authors: Jan Bietenbeck, Lukas Maschmann, Therese Nilsson, Devon Spika
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
abstract: We examine whether preventive health care uptake varies with cultural background related to patience and risk-taking. We combine individual-level survey data on preventive care use from 27 European countries with country-level preference measures from the Global Preferences Survey. To reduce confounding from institutional and economic correlates of culture, we focus on second-generation immigrants, who were born and currently reside in the same country – and thus face the same health care system and broad economic environment – but differ in inherited cultural background through their parents’ countries of origin. We find that respondents from more patient cultural backgrounds are more likely to use preventive services, while those from more risk-tolerant backgrounds are less likely to do so. These patterns appear across multiple preventive care outcomes.
abstract_zh: 本文考察预防性医疗服务的利用是否因与耐心和风险偏好相关的文化背景而异。我们将来自27个欧洲国家的个体层面预防性护理使用调查数据，与全球偏好调查中的国家层面偏好指标相结合。为减少文化与制度、经济因素之间的混杂效应，我们聚焦于第二代移民——他们出生并居住在同一国家，因此面临相同的医疗体系与宏观经济环境，但通过父母的原籍国继承了不同的文化背景。研究发现，来自更具耐心文化背景的受访者更倾向于使用预防性服务，而来自更具风险容忍背景的受访者则较少使用。这一模式在多种预防性护理结果中均得到体现。

title: Neighborhood Effects and Missing Markets for Opportunity
title_zh: 邻里效应与机会市场的缺失
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Experimental and quasi-experimental studies show that childhood neighborhoods have substantial causal impacts on children’s adult earnings and other long-term socioeconomic outcomes. Several market failures are likely to lead to excessive residential segregation by parental income and to an under-supply of mixed-income neighborhoods. Missing markets for opportunity originate in capital market imperfections for borrowing on children’s future earnings, neighbor spillovers, behavioral biases, and housing search frictions. Customized housing mobility services combined with subsidized housing vouchers can help low-income families move to higher-opportunity areas. Place-based policies that create mixed-income neighborhoods appear to increase long-term outcomes for less-advantaged children.
abstract_zh: 实验与准实验研究表明，童年居住社区对儿童成年后的收入及其他长期社会经济结果具有显著的因果影响。多种市场失灵可能导致按父母收入划分的居住隔离过度，并造成混合收入社区供给不足。机会缺失的市场源于儿童未来收入借贷的资本市场不完善、邻里溢出效应、行为偏差以及住房搜寻摩擦。定制化住房流动服务与补贴性住房券相结合，可帮助低收入家庭迁往机会更多的区域。创建混合收入社区的属地化政策似乎能改善弱势儿童的长期发展结果。

title: Trade policy uncertainty, organization of firms, and the form of international trade
title_zh: 贸易政策不确定性、企业组织与国际贸易形式
abstract: This paper investigates the hypothesis that lower trade policy uncertainty (TPU) reduces the share of intrafirm trade in total trade. A significant change in US‐China TPU occurred in 2001 when China joined the WTO, providing a natural experiment to test this hypothesis. Using a difference‐in‐differences approach with industry‐level US data, I examine the trade effects of this change. The results indicate that the reduction in TPU between the US and China led to a significant increase in both US arm's‐length and intrafirm imports from China compared to pre‐WTO levels. Notably, the effect of TPU on arm's‐length trade is approximately twice that on intrafirm trade, with the disparity largely attributed to sunk costs. A simple model of production location and ownership choice under policy uncertainty provides a conceptual framework for understanding these findings.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文研究了贸易政策不确定性（TPU）降低会减少公司内贸易在总贸易中占比这一假说。2001年中国加入WTO使美中贸易政策不确定性发生显著变化，为检验该假说提供了自然实验。本文采用双重差分法，基于美国行业层面数据，考察了这一变化带来的贸易效应。结果表明，相较于入世前水平，美中贸易政策不确定性的降低显著增加了美国从中国的独立企业间贸易和公司内进口。值得注意的是，贸易政策不确定性对独立企业间贸易的影响约为公司内贸易的两倍，这一差异主要归因于沉没成本。一个关于政策不确定性下生产区位与所有权选择的简单模型，为理解上述发现提供了概念框架。

title: Learning at Scale: Infrastructure, Aid Effectiveness, and World Bank Performance
title_zh: 大规模学习：基础设施、援助有效性与世界银行绩效
authors: Lall, Somik, Su, Xinyi, Vagliasindi, Maria
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-09 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper reexamines aid effectiveness using ex-post economic rates of return from 2,500 World Bank–financed infrastructure projects over six decades. Three facts emerge. First, average value creation is high: the mean economic rate of return is 24 percent (median 18.5 percent). Second, returns rise over time: after relative stability through the mid‑1980s, economic rates of return increased from the late 1980s onward, consistent with improved selection, design, and delivery. Third, economic rates of return are systematically higher in countries with weak institutions. In such countries, high-quality World Bank performance is associated with about a 12‑point increase in the average economic rate of return. A plausible mechanism is talent deployment. Higher‑quality task team leaders are disproportionately assigned to the most challenging contexts and linked to faster time‑to‑effectiveness and higher economic rates of return, despite longer, more intensive implementation. Overall, alongside country fundamentals, World Bank performance and talent deployment materially raise returns to scarce capital—especially where governance is weak.
abstract_zh: 本文利用世界银行60年间2500个基础设施项目的事后经济回报率，重新审视援助有效性。研究发现三个事实：第一，平均价值创造水平较高——经济回报率均值为24%（中位数为18.5%）；第二，回报率随时间递增——在20世纪80年代中期前保持相对稳定后，自80年代末起经济回报率持续上升，这与项目筛选、设计及交付质量的改善相吻合；第三，制度薄弱国家的经济回报率系统性更高。在此类国家中，世界银行的高质量绩效可使平均经济回报率提升约12个百分点。其潜在机制在于人才配置：更优质的项目团队负责人被不成比例地分配到最具挑战性的环境中，尽管面临更长周期、更高强度的实施过程，却能显著缩短项目见效时间并提升经济回报率。总体而言，除国家基本面因素外，世界银行的绩效表现与人才配置能实质性提升稀缺资本的回报率——尤其在治理薄弱地区效果更为显著。
